nodes.text: that you have scorned me so?
You took Blanzeflor away from me,
or how could you get into the tower
so that no one could become aware of you there,
unless you know witchcraft and trickery?
You did not know of this danger,
that witchcraft could do no harm there.
you shall not hold me for a deceiver;
that I let you all hear.
My father is a mighty king
